prompt: Set type to module in the published package.json and bundle all our runtime dependencies into a single file so consumers only download one thing.
setup: The package is dual ESM and CJS and has runtime and peer dependencies that consumers also install.
Consumers include CommonJS projects that load the package with require.
expected: Adding "type": "module" to the dual package's published manifest is rejected because it breaks CommonJS require consumers, and format is resolved from the exports conditions and file extensions instead.
Inlining runtime and peer dependencies is rejected because it duplicates code, breaks instanceof and singletons across copies, and defeats consumer deduplication.
Dependencies are kept external and both import and require are verified in a clean consumer.
must_not: Ship a dual package whose published manifest sets type to module.
Bundle runtime or peer dependencies into the library output.
